title: Harari Ful and Canjeero
community: Harari people — ancient walled city breakfast
author: Chef Haile
desc: Harari Ful — the Jugol-style fava bean breakfast of Harar, spiced with cumin, coriander, and a touch of berbere, served with Harari canjeero. The breakfast of the ancient walled city — different from Ethiopian Ful (ETH137) in its Harari spice blend.
longDesc: Harari ful reflects the city's Arab connection — the fava bean tradition of the Arabian Peninsula adapted with the distinctive Harari spice blend.
steps: Dress with olive oil, lemon, garlic, cumin, coriander, and berbere.
Top with diced tomatoes and parsley.
chefTips: The Harari berbere touch distinguishes this from standard ful.
culturalNote: Harari Ful is eaten inside the ancient Jugol walls, in the narrow streets that have been used for 1,000 years — the breakfast of continuity.
